scope: Optional dual ordinary/generator compilation of the core and subsequently loaded Lisp libraries. Real suspension through higher-order functions and CLOS is verified; no thread API, scheduler, or full McCLIM compatibility claim.

configuration.compiler: COMPILER::*RESUMABLE-FUNCTIONS* = :dual; T remains generator-only facade mode; NIL remains the default ordinary mode
configuration.loadTimeValues: One initialization per source HIR occurrence shared by both implementations; initializers execute synchronously
configuration.closures: Ordinary and generator entries share lexical cells; nested generator bodies use generator facades to avoid exponential duplication
configuration.stringLiterals: Retain direct FFI:CL->JS constant-string emission to avoid recursive ARRAY-TO-RAW-STRING bootstrap calls

node.command: npm --prefix tests run build:resumable && npm --prefix tests run test:resumable

browser.scope: Load and supplied API assertions; GUI verification is separate

browserAssertions.reproduction: Concatenate tests/performance/resumable.lisp, tests/resumable/checks.lisp and tests/resumable/alexandria-checks.lisp; pass that file to node tests/mcclim/probe.mjs alexandria REPORT CHECKS --browser valtan-resumable

compilerRegressions.command: npm --prefix tests run build:ansi && node --test --test-name-pattern='compiler-regressions|compiler control regressions' tests/ansi/integration.test.mjs

ordinaryMode.command: npm --prefix tests run build:performance && node tests/performance/verify.mjs

limitations: No scheduler, locks or Bordeaux Threads backend.
Native JavaScript callback boundaries (including package iteration and native error delivery) are not generally resumable.
Blocking host operations and synchronous load-time initialization still require integration.
Dual builds emit more code; no end-to-end startup or scheduling performance improvement is claimed.
Fresh full McCLIM drawing checks against this dual build are running separately, not counted as passed here.
